item.title: Symptoms and Diagnosis of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
item.description: PCOS symptoms include irregular periods, excess hair growth or hair loss, acne, depression, and insulin resistance. Learn how to spot the signs and how to get diagnosed.

item.title: 5 Expert Tips for Coping With Eco-Anxiety
item.description: If you’re deeply concerned about climate change and human inaction to it, you’re not alone. Here’s what “climate aware” mental health professionals recommend.

item.title: A Guide to Asthma Treatment and How to Use an Inhaler
item.description: Discover what asthma treatments are effective, including inhalers. Learn about usage techniques and medication types, and develop an asthma action plan for better symptom management.

item.title: How to Treat a Gunshot Wound Until Emergency Help Arrives
item.description: Learn how to properly treat a gunshot wound by assessing the scene, alerting authorities, and applying pressure to stop bleeding until emergency help arrives.

item.title: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) Treatment: Medication and Lifestyle Changes
item.description: Antibiotic drugs are considered the first line of treatment for urinary tract infections (UTIs). Other strategies may be used in some situations.

item.title: GLP-1s May Cause Hair Thinning in the First Year — But It’s Likely Temporary
item.description: A new study confirms that people taking GLP-1s are more likely to experience hair loss. The good news? It’s probably reversible. Here’s how to deal.

item.title: Type 2 Diabetes and Obesity: How to Break the Vicious Cycle
item.description: These 2 chronic diseases are interconnected in many ways. Managing both conditions together can help improve blood sugar levels and excess weight.

item.title: How to Manage Steroid Side Effects During AAV Treatment
item.description: Corticosteroids can be an effective way to treat ANCA-associated vasculitis. Get to know steroids’ risks, from gaining weight to developing infections.

item.title: Aging With Rheumatoid Arthritis: Challenges and Adaptations
item.description: Learn how aging with rheumatoid arthritis presents challenges and comorbidities, and why aggressive treatment remains crucial in older adults.

item.title: Do You Judge Foods As ‘Good’ or ‘Bad’? It Could Be Harming Your Mental Health
item.description: Labeling foods as "good" or "bad" can impact your mental health and promote disordered eating. Here's how viewing food as neutral may support positive body image.
